components.name: Accordion
components.description: The Accordion component is a flexible UI primitive built with React and TypeScript. It allows users to expand and collapse content sections, making it ideal for FAQs, documentation, and content-heavy interfaces.

props.name: items
props.description: The accordion items to render, in order.

props.name: allowMultiple
props.description: When true, multiple items can stay open at once; when false (default), opening an item closes any other open item.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Indexes of items that start open.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root wrapper element.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the root wrapper element.

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Classes for each item's outer container.

props.name: itemStyle
props.description: Inline styles for each item's outer container.

props.name: headerClassName
props.description: Classes for each item's clickable header button.

props.name: headerStyle
props.description: Inline styles for each item's clickable header button — applied unconditionally, not only on hover.

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: Classes for the title text span inside the header.

props.name: titleStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the title text span inside the header.

props.name: iconClassName
props.description: Classes for the expand/collapse icon wrapper.

props.name: iconStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the expand/collapse icon wrapper.

props.name: contentWrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the collapsible grid wrapper around the content.

props.name: contentWrapperStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the collapsible grid wrapper around the content.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the inner content container.

props.name: contentStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the inner content container.

props.name: hoverClassName
props.description: Extra classes merged onto the header last, so they can override the built-in hover styling; note they apply at rest too, not only on hover.

props.name: hoverStyle
props.description: Extra inline styles merged onto the header; since inline styles can't express :hover, these apply unconditionally. Prefer hoverClassName.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Declared for future theming but not currently applied anywhere in the render.

props.name: radius
props.description: Declared for future theming but not currently applied anywhere in the render.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Declared for future theming but not currently applied anywhere in the render.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration in milliseconds of the expand/collapse grid-row transition.

props.name: iconOpen
props.description: Custom icon shown when an item is open; defaults to a ChevronUp.

props.name: iconClose
props.description: Custom icon shown when an item is closed; defaults to a ChevronDown.

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (params: { item: AccordionItem; index: number; open: boolean; toggle: () => void; }) => ReactNode
props.description: Fully custom renderer for each item, replacing the default header/content markup. Receives the item, its index, open state, and a toggle callback.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: The Avatar component displays profile images, user initials, or fallback icons. Supports multiple sizes, variants, online/offline status, rings, and click interactions.

props.name: src
props.description: Image source URL. When missing, or when it fails to load, the fallback initials (or icon) render instead.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessibility label for the image, and the source used to derive initials when fallback isn't provided.

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar dimensions. "responsive" currently resolves to the same fixed size as "md" internally.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape of the avatar: full circle, rounded corners, or square.

props.name: isOnline
props.description: Shows a status dot using the success color to indicate the user is online.

props.name: isOffline
props.description: Shows a status dot using the muted color to indicate the user is offline.

props.name: ring
props.description: Adds a ring outline around the avatar.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Explicit fallback text (e.g. initials) shown instead of the image; not auto-truncated, unlike the initials derived from alt.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler; when provided, the avatar becomes a focusable, keyboard-activatable button.

props.name: statusPosition
props.description: Corner where the online/offline status dot is placed.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the avatar's root element.

props.name: statusClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the status dot.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the avatar's root element.

props.name: statusStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the status dot.

props.name: imageClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the rendered element.

props.name: fallbackClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the fallback wrapper shown when there is no image.

props.name: iconClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the default user icon shown when there is no image and no initials.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.description: React avatar group with overlapping stack, background rings and an automatic +N overflow counter — built with Tailwind CSS.

props.name: children
props.description: Avatar elements (or any circular content).

props.name: max
props.description: Show at most this many; the rest collapse into a "+N" counter.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the "+N" overflow counter only — it does not resize the avatar children, so match it to their size yourself.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Overlap amount between items.

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Customize the wrapper span around each visible avatar item.

props.name: counterClassName
props.description: Customize the "+N" overflow counter.

<AvatarGroup max={3}>
  <Avatar src="/u1.jpg" alt="Ana Silva" size="md" />
  <Avatar src="/u2.jpg" alt="Ben Cole" size="md" />
  <Avatar src="/u3.jpg" alt="Cara Diaz" size="md" />
  <Avatar src="/u4.jpg" alt="Dev Patel" size="md" />
  <Avatar src="/u5.jpg" alt="Eve Wong" size="md" />
